description: Header file declaring functions, structures, and conditional includes for integrating ngtcp2 (QUIC protocol implementation) with libcurl, specifically for the ngtcp2 backend and optional nghttp3 support.

methods.name: Curl_ngtcp2_ver
methods.description: Outputs the version information for the ngtcp2 backend.

methods.name: Curl_cf_ngtcp2_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ngtcp2 connection filter for a curl session.

methods.name: Curl_conn_is_ngtcp2
methods.description: Checks whether the current connection is using ngtcp2 (QUIC).
